response.original_title: Dr. Inconspicuous & Not So Special Agent Bob
response.overview: After a mission goes terribly wrong, Dr. Inconspicuous, an elite spy, is forced to pair with the not-so-special Agent Bob. The two are sent on a wild-goose chase full of intrigue, action, and inconspicuous-ness as they discover the mystery behind the CIA Director's kidnapping.
